title: Warner Bros. Deal Collapse Would Cost the Ellisons $9.8 Billion
title_zh: 华纳兄弟交易失败将使埃里森家族损失 98 亿美元
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Larry Ellison and his family would be on the hook for $9.8 billion if Paramount Skydance Corp.’s deal to buy Warner Bros. Discovery Inc.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——如果派拉蒙 Skydance Corp. 收购华纳兄弟探索公司 (Warner Bros. Discovery Inc.) 的交易成功，拉里·埃里森 (Larry Ellison) 及其家人将面临 98 亿美元的损失。

title: KKR, Blackstone Sign $16 Billion Kuwait Oil Deal
title_zh: KKR 与 Blackstone 签署 160 亿美元科威特石油交易
summary: The companies that manage Kuwait’s oil sector signed a $16 billion lease agreement with a group of investors led by Blackstone, Brookfield and KKR.
summary_zh: 管理科威特石油行业的公司与以 Blackstone、Brookfield 和 KKR 为首的投资者集团签署了价值 160 亿美元的租赁协议。

title: Blackstone credit arm nears deal for HSBC’s Australian loan book – report

summary: HSBC is carrying out a broad global reorganisation under chief executive Georges Elhedery, who took the role last September.
summary_zh: 汇丰银行在去年 9 月上任的首席执行官 Georges Elhedery 的领导下正在进行广泛的全球重组。
